name: Speed Boat Ideation
deliverable: Visual discovery of operational drag factors and mechanical engines

steps.text: Draw a boat labeled with the product or team, a destination, and an empty sea around it.
Have people add anchors for what slows progress and engines for what speeds it, then explain one of each.
Cluster and rank the anchors, turn the top ones into owned commitments, and name the engines to protect.

failure: Half-working looks like a decorated boat with dozens of anchors and no ranking: no decision is made.
intervention: Ask for the two anchors that cost the most progress this month, and assign each one an owner.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A visual retrospective format; no origin given in the source.
